Intent: Keep asset and brand delivery reliable
Formula: Accepted milestone deliverables completed by agreed date / milestone deliverables due
Evidence: ClickUp due dates and acceptance records
Notes: Re-baseline only when an asset request or scope change is approved

Intent: Measure brief comprehension and usable quality
Formula: Assets accepted without major rework at first formal review / assets formally reviewed
Notes: Copy edits and minor export corrections are not major rework

Intent: Keep all assets within the approved visual system
Formula: Brand audit checks passed / applicable brand audit checks
Evidence: Brand checklist across UI, icon, illustration, and marketing samples
Notes: Audit against approved typography, color, composition, icon, illustration, and image rules

Intent: Prevent integration delays from incorrect files
Formula: Delivered assets matching requested dimensions, ratio, format, color mode, naming, and safe area / assets delivered
Notes: Incorrect export variants count as a failed check

Intent: Ensure visuals work in accessible UI contexts
Formula: Applicable checks passed / applicable checks performed
Evidence: Contrast checks, non-text contrast, non-color meaning, and alt-text guidance
Notes: Decorative assets should be identified; informative assets need text alternatives

Intent: Protect future editing and commercial use
Formula: Assets with editable source, export, ownership or license record, and usage notes / assets delivered
Notes: No unlicensed fonts, stock, icons, or AI-generated assets with unclear commercial terms

Intent: Avoid producing attractive assets that fail inside the product
Formula: Assets reviewed inside intended UI or marketing layout / assets requiring contextual review
Evidence: Linked UI frames or marketing mockups
Notes: UI/UX Designer confirms fit; Graphic Designer confirms brand quality

Formula: Approved assets requiring designer-caused major rework / approved assets
Notes: Do not count approved product changes or changed technical requirements

Intent: Make reusable production assets easy to discover
Formula: Required library categories delivered and documented / categories agreed in asset plan
Evidence: Asset inventory for logo, app icon, illustration, iconography, achievements, and templates
Notes: Category completion requires source, exports, naming, and usage guidance

Intent: Keep brand and interaction work aligned
Formula: Asset batches reviewed with UI/UX Designer before approval / asset batches delivered
